name: Shiori
message: "It's strange how it's always nice and quiet here, even though it's right next to a fairly busy road."

name: Shiori
message: "We're still in the middle of the city, yet it feels cut off from the hustle and bustle of everyday life... It really makes you think that a deity actually resides here."

name: Shiori
message: "Since we're here, we might as well offer a prayer."
How much should I put in?
(5 yen)

name: Shiori
message: "May this bring us good ties and fortune. Now, let's make a wish."

name: Shiori
message: "One hundred fifteen... 'ii goen'... oh, as in good ties, good fortune. Is there someone you're hoping to bond with? Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "One thousand one hundred eighty-two... 'ii, hani, hafu'... Huh? I don't get it..."

name: Shiori
message: "...Huh? 'Ii yatsu'? Huh? As in, good guy?"

name: Shiori
message: "You just addressed a deity so casually... You really aren't afraid of anything, are you?"

name: Shiori
message: "Now then, shall we get going?"
Shiori-san's gone.
Where am I?
"Oh?"
"A visitor. How unusual."
"You seem to have ties with the dead. And quite a lot of them at that."
"You shouldn't get too attached to them. They'll end up pulling you along."
"Now then, you should head back. You mustn't make your ghost friend worry."
"Come again if you feel like it. Let's have a nice, long chat next time."
What just...

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, thank goodness! You're back!"

name: Shiori
message: "You vanished so suddenly, I panicked... I thought you'd been spirited away again..."

name: Shiori
message: "Are you okay? How are you feeling? What in the world happened?"
"I met the deity."

name: Shiori
message: "The deity? You mean... the deity summoned you?"

name: Shiori
message: "You were literally spirited away just now... But since you got back immediately, the deity must've meant no harm, right?"

name: Shiori
message: "...No, that's not good. I shouldn't be getting suspicious of a deity, even if it was the same deity that made you vanish out of thin air."

name: Shiori
message: "If anything, I should be grateful. The one who saved you when you were spirited away was probably this shrine's deity, after all."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you so much. I don't have a single yen to offer, but please accept my heartfelt gratitude."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, that should do it. I hope my gratitude reaches them."

name: Shiori
message: "But still... Ehehe, you're amazing, meeting a deity just like that."

name: Shiori
message: "You can even see ghosts. You could say you're a natural at the supernatural."

name: Shiori
message: "Now then, shall we get going? With a deity watching over you, I'm sure everything will go well today."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, you really like this place, don't you? Why don't we rest a little?"
(Pray)
(Leave)

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, are you done already? Not tired?"

name: Shiori
message: "You're good? Okay, in that case, shall we get going?"

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? Again?"

name: Shiori
message: "You're really devout, aren't you? That's nice. I'm sure the deity is happy too."
How much should I put in?
(5 yen)

name: Shiori
message: "Four hundred fifteen... ah, 'yoi goen,' as in better ties, better fortune. An upgraded version of 'ii goen,' I see."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, let's make a proper, heartfelt wish so it'll reach the deity."

name: Shiori
message: "At first I figured it was a year or something, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, 'irojiro' as in fair-skinned?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Huh? I got it right? ...Is the deity fair-skinned, though? ...Okay, you're just playing around now, aren't you?"

name: Shiori
message: "Got your prayer in? In that case, shall we get going?"

name: Shiori
message: "Here we are again. Don't tell me, you're..."
(Pray)
(Leave)

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, right, of course. That would've been too much."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay then, let's rest a bit and get going."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, I knew it..."

name: Shiori
message: "Now I'm starting to worry about your mental state..."

name: Shiori
message: "What's making you cling to the deity so much? I don't understand..."

name: Shiori
message: "Is it my fault?"

name: Shiori
message: "Am I... unconsciously draining your life force or something?"

name: Shiori
message: "That's not it? Really? I'm kind of getting nervous... What if I get exorcised or something?"
How much should I put in?
(5 yen)

name: Shiori
message: "If I remember right, 500 yen... isn't a good offering. As the last coinage denomination, it suggests that tie has run its course."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? Are you trying to cut ties with me? You're not... right? Right...?"

name: Shiori
message: "Fuku, koi... ah, 'fuku koi,' as in may fortune come."

name: Shiori
message: "But knowing you, I bet it means something else. Probably not fuku as in fortune. Maybe meat? Nikukoi..."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? Is it really just 'may fortune come'? Looks like I was reading too much into it. You got me."

name: Shiori
message: "Now then, we've prayed three times already. We should be plenty blessed by now."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, let's get going."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm really starting to worry now... You're practically obsessed at this point... with a deity, no less..."

name: Shiori
message: "I know you want to go and visit again, but... maybe wait for another day."

name: Shiori
message: "At this rate, you're really going to end up broke..."
(Pray)
(Leave)

name: Shiori
message: "Thank goodness... Yes, let's do that."

name: Shiori
message: "Gratitude is important, but so is money."

name: Shiori
message: "I see... right. I figured you'd say that..."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, I won't stop you anymore."
How much should I put in?
(5 yen)

name: Shiori
message: "Triple seven, the lucky number. I wonder if that means anything to Japanese deities."

name: Shiori
message: "Well, if it's a gambling deity, maybe it does. Just kidding, ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "Wait, wait, what, you're freaking me out, I'm seriously getting scared now."

name: Shiori
message: "Everything about this is terrifying, from the fact that you're carrying that much cash to the way you just ditched the wordplay and just went in swinging with raw money!"

name: Shiori
message: "Are you sure you're okay? Is something going on? Money is important, you know?"

name: Shiori
message: "Even if there's a wish you really want granted... this is, just... um, maybe think about it a little...?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... ahhh... you put it in... oh no... oh nooooo..."
"Sheesh, good grief... I couldn't bear to watch anymore, so I called you here."
"Only humans delight in offerings. If you're just here to pray, there's no need for money. Your faith alone is enough."
"I'm sure the shrine's caretakers appreciate it, though, since upkeep costs money."
"If you're just here to visit, putting your hands together is enough. As for whether I'll call you here again... we'll see if I'm in the mood."
"Don't ever use your money like that again, understood?"
"Now go on home. Come back if you feel like it."
"But not today. You've done more than enough already. Understood?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, you're back."

name: Shiori
message: "I knew what was happening, but I still can't help panicking when you suddenly disappear like that. So, how was it? Did you meet the deity?"
"I got chased away..."
"I got scolded..."

name: Shiori
message: "I mean, of course... To be blunt, you were being really clingy."

name: Shiori
message: "You shouldn't go bothering the deity, so let's just go, okay?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm not sure what to do. Maybe I should be a bit stricter from now on..."
(Pray)
(Leave)
I should probably stop now...

name: Shiori
message: "Thank goodness. You made the right call."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, let's go. Before you take out your wallet again."

(Housing Complex)
"After all's said and done, you did throw quite a large sum into the offering box. I suppose I should reward you somehow."
"Is there a wish you absolutely must have granted?"
"My power as a deity is fading. I can't say how much I can do, but... it's worth a try. Go on, tell me."
"World domination."
"I want to win the lottery."
"I want to live an easy life forever."
"Nope, that's far beyond me."
"Anything else?"
"I can't grant a wish that big. Setting that aside, take your time."
"The lottery, eh? Hrm, I'm afraid I can't grant that."
"But here's a word of advice..."
"Would it not have been better to spend all that money you offered on lottery tickets instead?"
"Think carefully about how you use your money. Your dreams might be easier to reach than you think."
"Forever, is it? I'm sorry to say that—"
"No, there may be a way. Yes, of course..."
"Close your eyes. Let go of all tension."
"To live the easy life forever... Very well. I shall grant that wish."

name: Shiori
message: "What's taking you so long...?"

name: Shiori
message: "You returned once already, so you can come back again, right?"

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe all those prayers upset the deity... This is worrying..."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh? Hello, doggie."

name: Shiori
message: "My, oh my... looks like you can see me."

name: Shiori
message: "Will you let me pet you? Ehehe, you're so friendly. Such a nice coat too... Are you lost? Where's your home?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'll help you find your way later. I'm waiting for someone right now. Will you wait with me?"

name: Shiori
message: "I see. Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "What's taking you so long...?"
